text:
Priya (Support): FYI incoming from Stellar AI — their March invoice shows 138,420 tokens billed under 'Embedding calls' but their dashboard per-route report only shows ~18,312. They're escalated, says it's a huge unexpected EOM jump.

Dan (Billing): Ack. Can you drop account id + invoice id?

Priya (Support): acct_stellar, invoice 2024-03-31-INV-0042. Customer pasted screenshot and a CSV. They also flagged a request spike around 2024-03-31 23:57-23:59 UTC.

Maya (CS): I can take this. Asking the customer if they ran any bulk re-indexing or background jobs.

Priya (Support): Customer replies: "we did a one-off doc reindex on 03/31 to refresh embeddings, ran from our infra using our API key via the Python SDK". They thought SDK from their side behaves like a local op and would match dashboard counts.

Alex (Eng-Infra): If they used their live API key then it will generate billable token_events. Dashboard per-route views sometimes filter out internal/bulk routes (we aggregate user-facing routes). I'll check token_events and routing logs.

Alex (Eng-Infra): Running quick query now:
```sql
-- tokens for acct_stellar around EOM spike
SELECT event_ts, route, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_stellar'
  AND event_ts BETWEEN '2024-03-31T23:50:00Z' AND '2024-04-01T00:10:00Z'
GROUP BY event_ts, route
ORDER BY event_ts;
```

Alex (Eng-Infra): Results: total ~120,432 tokens from route 'bulk-embed-batch' between 23:57:12 and 23:59:40. Dashboard per-route UI excludes routes matching /^bulk-/ by default, so the per-route report shows only ~18k from their normal prod traffic. Invoice uses raw token_events (all billable calls) so it includes the bulk job.

Dan (Billing): That matches. Invoice = raw ledger from token_events. Dashboard is a filtered/aggregated view. So discrepancy explained.

Priya (Support): Customer says they didn't realize using their live key would be billed like production traffic. They're asking for a credit; this was a one-off reindex.

Dan (Billing): Policy: calls with customer keys are billable. However given it's EOM and clearly a single accidental job, we can offer a goodwill credit. Propose we credit tokens for the bulk job minus a small portion — recommend 100k tokens credit at their plan rate as a one-off. I'll need engineering confirmation it's not an ongoing pattern.

Alex (Eng-Infra): Confirmed single job, repeated requests show no other spikes. Logs show API key prefix 'rk_live_' associated with requests. Full log snippet:
```
2024-03-31T23:57:12Z INFO bulk-embed-job started account=acct_stellar api_key_prefix=rk_live_abc123 batches=12 requests_per_batch=1000 avg_tokens=10
2024-03-31T23:59:40Z INFO bulk-embed-job finished account=acct_stellar tokens_total=120432 route=bulk-embed-batch
```

Maya (CS): I'll frame this to the customer: explain dashboard vs invoice difference, confirm it was their live key, and offer the goodwill credit. If they accept, we execute billing adj.

Priya (Support): Customer accepted partial credit offer conditionally. Action items: (1) Dan to run billing adjustment/credit for invoice 2024-03-31-INV-0042 for the agreed token amount, (2) Alex to add a short dashboard UI note explaining "per-route view excludes bulk/internal routes by default" and add a toggle to include them, (3) Alex to push infra best-practice doc to warn customers to use service/worker keys for background reindexing or use internal discounting mechanism, (4) Maya/Priya to confirm closure with customer once credit applied.

Dan (Billing): I'll open billing-ticket #BILL-2024-987 and post the ledger PR. ETA today EOD.

Alex (Eng-Infra): I'll open GH PR to: a) add the dashboard disclosure + toggle, b) add a filters change so support can run "include_bulk=true" exports, and c) add a check to our worker templates so they prefer internal-service keys for scheduled reindexes. Target hotfix in next 48 hrs.

Priya (Support): I'll draft the customer message and send after Dan confirms the credit is posted. Thanks team :white_check_mark: 

billing-bot: Billing adjustment BILL-2024-987 created and assigned to Dan (Billing).
